At 7.15 a.m. April 15, 1932, acting on the authority

Sih Sien (傅雪仙) aliases Sih Sing Dau (雪晴涛), native

quantity of communist literature was found in his room.

As a result of watch maintained on the premises, two
more suspects named Tsang Tien Chang (張天祥) and Tseu
Doong Liang (周童良) were arrested later during the day.

The arrested persons will appear before the Shanghai

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Dzung Chi Ming (陳啟明) 24. M/Unemployed.
native of Nyi-chong. taken by me Interpreter Chiu.
translated
at Sinsa on the 15-4-32. and interpreted by Interpreter Chiu.

I am residing at No.21 Hwa Zung Li (華順里) Yates Road. I have studied 8 years in my native country. In August 1930, through my friend Mr.Yih's (葉) introduction, I came to Shanghai ans was employed in the Commercial Press, Paoshan Rd, Chapei, as a proof-reader, with salary at $30 per month. Owing to the conflict between China and Japan this year I was thrown out of my job and removed to the present address. I never joined any party. On the morning of 15th, April 1932 members of the S.M.P. and Shanghai Public Safety Bureau came to my room to search and from one of the baskets they found 1 book and some papers which proved to be communistic literature. The book and papers are the belongings of my female friend Soong Ts Tseu (宋子洲) she is a student of an Arts School, Market Street French Town. Her brother Soong Yue Chun (宋岳鈞) was a fellow clerk of mine when I was at the Zung Yue Transport Co. Nyichong, Hupei. I knew Soong Ts Tseu last year when she came to Shanghai and visited me with a letter of introduction written by her brother. She placed the stuff in my room at the end of last year on account of the school being closed for holidays and promised to take it away when school re-opened. I didn't know the contents of the basket was communistic literature. I never joined any union or any communistic party. In Shanghai I live with my wife Dzung Tsang Sz (陳張氏) only. I have no relations and I have never been charged before.

Signed: Dzung Chi Ming.

以下是 Dzung Chi Ming (陳啟明)，24岁，男/无业，
仪征籍人士的陈述，由我记录，
于1932年4月15日在新闸，
由翻译 Chiu 口译。

我住在叶茨路华顺里21号。我在家乡读过8年书。1930年8月，经朋友叶先生（Mr. Yih）介绍，我来到上海，受雇于闸北宝山路商务印书馆，担任校对员，月薪30元。因今年中日冲突，我失业并搬至现址。我从未加入任何党派。1932年4月15日上午，上海公共租界工部局警务处成员和上海公安局人员来到我的房间搜查，从其中一个篮子里找到了一本书和一些文件，经查证为共产主义文献。该书和文件属于我的朋友宋子洲（Soong Ts Tseu），她是法租界市场街一所艺术学校的学生。她的哥哥宋岳鈞（Soong Yue Chun）是我在湖北仪征中悦运输公司工作时的同事。去年宋子洲来上海时，持其兄写的介绍信拜访我，我因此结识了她。去年年底，因学校放假，她将那些东西放在我房间里，并承诺开学时取走。我不知道篮子里装的是共产主义文献。我从未加入任何工会或共产党。在上海，我只与妻子陈张氏（Dzung Tsang Sz）同住。我没有亲属，以前也从未被指控过。

签名：Dzung Chi Ming。
